headline: EMC’s -50.00% move and elevated volatility across several CONS names lead today’s coverage priorities.
market_take: Trading was volatile, with 54 unusual-trading alerts, including 20 high-severity alerts shown. CONS had the broadest cluster of notable moves, while PROP activity was also prominent through sharp gains, declines and volume spikes. Recent filings included TEKA and WINDOW quarterly results, SAMCO guidance change, XBIO’s annual-report amendment and WINDOW’s investment in a new company.
